subject: BuildSync technical intake — docs-to-engineer demo scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Bishop <alex@buildsync.io>
To: rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quickstart trial — request for technical walkthrough

Hi Rachel,

We just finished the Quickstart flow and spun up a small sandbox model endpoint. I'm Alex on the engineering side at BuildSync — we evaluate inference vendors for embedding and chat features. The docs CTA suggested I reach out if we wanted a deeper technical walkthrough.

High-level asks:
- Live demo of routing and how you handle fallback variants (we saw mention of model variants in the docs)
- Quantization/latency profiles for 8-bit vs 4-bit on common GPU types
- Example of KV cache behavior with a chat application that has 8–12 turn dialogs

We're a small infra team — I can join a 30–45 minute call. My availability (PST):
- Thu May 20: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–17:00
- Fri May 21: 09:00–12:00

Notes: we have requirement questions around SSO for the console and data retention for the dedicated plan (we're in early procurement).

Thanks,
Alex Bishop
Senior Platform Engineer | BuildSync
Attachments: buildsync-quickstart-log.txt (text)
From: rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com
To: Alex Bishop <alex@buildsync.io>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood-inference.com, camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quickstart trial — request for technical walkthrough

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for trying the Quickstart. I looped in Ben (SDR) to help with scheduling and Camila from Docs/Onramp to run the technical walkthrough — she'll cover routing, KV cache, and concrete latency numbers.

Quick reply: 30–45 minutes should be enough for an initial technical review. Can you confirm whether you prefer an interactive sandbox demo (we'll provision a temporary dedicated instance for the call) or a screenshare + logs walkthrough? For SSO / data retention questions, Camila can bring our compliance notes and Ben can follow up with procurement steps.

I opened a tentative Calendly slot for our team: https://calendly.com/redwood-tech/30min — if you prefer the times above, choose one and we'll lock it.

Attached a short one-pager that summarizes the Quickstart and recommended checklist for sandbox demos.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_quickstart_onepager.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks Rachel — I booked the 30min slot for Thu May 20 at 10:30 PST via the Calendly link (it showed as available). A couple clarifications before the call:
- Preferred demo type: screenshare + a short live run in a temporary sandbox (we don't need a pre-provisioned dedicated instance, screenshare is fine)
- On SSO: we use Okta and will need to know if we can SAML-enable the Private control plane; if not immediately, we'll need a procurement note (what's typical turnaround for enterprise setup?)
- Data retention: our security team asks whether logs/audit traces are retained in-hosted by default and the retention length; is there an exportable audit log?

I've attached a short list of SSO items from our security team. If there are any pre-read docs you'd like us to review, point me to them and I'll send them to our security lead.

Regards,
Alex
